entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.comment: Comments (continuation) 8% VAT rate is applied to certain equipment for blind persons (CN codes: 8442 30 00, 8471, 8472 90). Devices for writing and reading texts in Braille are subject to the reduced rate regardless of CN codes.
